originalSubject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution

payload.subject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution
payload.text:
Hi Kaustav,

Thanks for picking this up. Answers to your two questions:

1. Which account: we do not have a Cision/ CisionOne account - this inquiry is from a prospective source, not an existing customer. Hashtag Web3 (a United States organization publishing English-language crypto and Web3 news) started with the email route to your support inbox on November 4; your Support AI and the CisionOne support team thread are the same conversation you just picked up. Our aim: our published news articles tracked as content from Hashtag Web3 in CisionOne monitoring streams (and inclusion in the media database if that is part of the setup path for a prospective source).

2. Is the RSS feed already set up: yes. Our feed is live and self-hosted:

- RSS 2.0: https://hashtagweb3.com/news/feed.xml (headline, summary, original publication date, canonical link per item)
- Publication: https://hashtagweb3.com/news
- Example native article: https://hashtagweb3.com/bitgetthai
- About: https://hashtagweb3.com/about - Contact: hi@hashtagweb3.com

Reach context: 55 million job-post views in the last year, 26 million LinkedIn views last month, 150,000 newsletter subscribers, 60,000 Telegram members, weekly X Spaces with 20,000-40,000 listeners.

Editorial note: our workflow uses AI-assisted research and drafting with source and publication checks; our news listing also links to external publishers, and those external stories are not supplied as our own content.

Since we have no account, please let us know if a different setup path (form, contact, or onboarding step) applies, and we will follow it exactly.

Thank you,
Hashtag Web3 - hi@hashtagweb3.com
